sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Wholesale Trade of Aged Scotch and Bordeaux Wines

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia - National unitary jurisdiction; planned domicile Bogotá D.C. (Departamento de Cundinamarca); no sub-state company-law or tax distinction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified Napoleonic tradition; Código de Comercio, Decreto 410 de 1971; Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regulated by Ley 1258 de 2008; unitary national administrative enforcement via DIAN and Superintendencia de Sociedades)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-EU Trade Agreement (Ley 1669 de 2013; in force since 1 August 2013) - relevant for French Bordeaux wine tariff treatment
Colombia-UK Trade Continuity Agreement (applied since 1 January 2021 upon Brexit transition) - relevant for Scotch whisky market access
Colombia-US Trade Promotion Agreement (Ley 1143 de 2007; in force since 15 May 2012) - relevant for US dollar wire payment rails
Colombia-UK Double Taxation Arrangement (signed 5 December 2019; in force - verify effective-date table for dividend and royalty withholding in the operative year)
Colombia-France Double Taxation Agreement (signed 11 May 2021; ratification status to be re-verified at transaction closing)
OECD Inclusive Framework (Colombia acceded to OECD membership on 28 April 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation); Ley 1121 de 2006; Ley 1762 de 2015 (customs fraud and laundering); Ley 2195 de 2022; Circular Básica Jurídica C.E. 029 of 15 December 2014 (Superintendencia de Sociedades, as amended); Superintendencia de Sociedades Resolution 164 of 6 February 2020 (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUB, defining UBO as natural persons holding directly or indirectly 5% or more of shares, voting rights or profit participation, or exercising de facto control); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (single regulatory decree for commerce)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Existence and Good Standing of the foreign corporate shareholder (registry extract from UK Companies House, French Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney granted by the sole shareholder(s) to the Colombian local incorporation counsel for executing the incorporation deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of the shareholder's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of all Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) and subscribing shareholders
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public of each UBO's jurisdiction of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and AML financial-standing letters covering the funding account for share subscription and payment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent bank or issuing bank of the shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing bank is located in a Hague member state; otherwise Consular Legalization at the Colombian Embassy

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory negative vetting against OFAC SDN, UN Security Council consolidated lists, EU consolidated list, UIAF Listas Vinculantes (Lista Clinton) and Colombian counter-terrorism registries; mandatory domestic and foreign Politically Exposed Person (PEP) identification per Chapter X of Circular Básica Jurídica; SARLAFT risk matrix and customer risk classification must be executed pre-incorporation; any PEP-matched UBO triggers enhanced due diligence and senior management approval before incorporation proceeds.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social - www.rues.org.co) operated via Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá (www.ccb.org.co) using the 'Certificado de Homonimia' online service
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be expressed in Spanish; internationally registered trademarks or foreign parent-company names may be transliterated into Latin characters, but the legal denomination must include the suffix 'S.A.S.'; the name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Colombian company or trade name (homonimia principle)
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Banquero, Financiera Comercial, Asociación de Ahorro y Crédito, Cooperativa Financiera, Fondo de Pensiones, Fondo de Cesantías, Seguros, Aseguradora, Capitalización, Comisionista de Bolsa - prior authorization by Superintendencia Financiera required
Minas, Petróleo, Gas, Combustible, Energía, Hidrocarburos - prior authorization by Ministry of Mines and Energy required
Nación, República, Departamento, Municipio, Distrito, Estado - prior governmental authorization required
Terms contrary to public order, morality, or denominations that mislead the public regarding the company's regulated activity
Any name creating identity or substantial similarity with an existing registered company or protected trade name
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written reconsideration (recurso de reposición) before the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 working days, and subsequently an appeal (recurso de apelación) to the Superintendencia de Sociedades within 10 working days per Ley 1437 de 2011, attaching the RUES rejection notice, proposed by-laws and homonymy analysis; alternatively, the applicant may immediately correct the denomination and file a new homonymy certificate without penalty.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is acceptable only as the notification and correspondence address for the S.A.S.; it does NOT satisfy the statutory domestic-domicile requirement for the bonded-warehouse operator. For scope ISIC 4632 / NAICS 424820, an operational registered office and a DIAN-licensed bonded warehouse (depósito aduanero) located within an authorised Zona Primaria Aduanera are mandatory pre-operational requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 85% - DIAN customs authority conducts programmed and unannounced on-site inspections of bonded premises under Decreto 390 de 2016 and Decreto 349 de 2018; Superintendencia de Sociedades also performs risk-weighted verification visits of newly incorporated S.A.S. entities within the first fiscal year (sector classified as Medium_Risk_Enhanced).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Homonymy certificate (certificado de homonimia) - RUES / Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory minimum-wage-based tariff per Decreto 1074 de 2015 and CCB fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notary public fee for incorporation deed (escritura pública de constitución)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public (Superintendencia de Notariado y Registro tariff)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial scale computed on subscribed capital (approximately 1%, capped by minimum-wage brackets)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration tax on the incorporation deed (impuesto de registro)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Departamento de Cundinamarca / Registraduría de Instrumentos Públicos
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory rate under Articles 226-230 of Ley 223 de 1995 (approximately 0.5% to 1.0% of capital shown in the instrument; minimum tariff applies)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registration (matrícula mercantil) including filing of share-ledger signature and manager appointment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff equivalent to approximately 4% of one SMLMV plus denomination surcharges per CCB fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RUT/NIT pre-incorporation tax registration (obtención de NIT)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No fee; electronic issuance via DIAN portal

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial UBO registration in the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No fee; mandatory electronic filing per Resolution 164 of 2020

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostilles for four foreign documents (shareholder extract, POA, UBO passports, bank reference letters)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores / designated notarial authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-document fee of approximately USD 12 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation of foreign apostilled documents into Spanish
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of approximately USD 40 per page for a ten-page bundle

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal counsel retainership covering by-law drafting, AML/UBO file assembly, and DIAN bonded-warehouse licensing roadmap
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for cross-border S.A.S. incorporation engagements (fixed-fee or blended hourly)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preliminary DIAN consultation on bonded-warehouse authorization feasibility (pre-filing technical meeting)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee at pre-incorporation stage; formal application fee arises only at Stage 3 (operating license)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Código de Comercio de Colombia (Decree-Law 410 of 1971, Book II, Arts. 98-130) as supplemented by Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime, Arts. 1, 3, 5, 17-22) and Decree 1074 of 2015 (Title I, Registro Mercantil).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio territorial (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating under the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución / Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (private incorporation instrument registered with the Commercial Registry).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Colombian S.A.S. has no statutory minimum paid-up capital; shareholders may fix any sum in the by-laws with payment deferred up to two years. For bonded-trade operations, DIAN requires a separate customs guaranty bond (Póliza de Depósito Aduanero) and the applicable alcohol consumption tax registry, which are additional to the subscribed capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation instrument of the S.A.S. is approved and the subscribed share capital is acknowledged as fully subscribed. RESOLVED, that the registered office is fixed at [address] in [city], Colombia, subject to relocation protocol. RESOLVED, that [Name] and [Name] are appointed as legal representatives (gerentes) with joint authority, and [Name] as secretary. RESOLVED, that the legal representative is directed to process the RUT, register the bonded wine-spirits activity before DIAN, open the corporate bank account, and execute all necessary tax, customs, and labour filings to render this resolution fully operative.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio territorial via RUES online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a Certificado de Homónimos request through the RUES portal for up to three proposed corporate names. The certificate confirms that no identical company denomination or registered trademark exists. Upon issuance, reserve the selected name for 30 business days. Notarization is not required at this stage.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Homónimos application form
Identification document of the applicant (cédula or passport)
Power of attorney if filed through an authorized intermediary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a homonym is identified, file a revised name list via the same portal; appeal the technical rejection to the Cámara de Comercio registry officer within 10 business days; re-application is free of charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the S.A.S. Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública and all founding shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in accordance with Law 1258/2008 including the shareholders' intention to form a simplified stock company, subscribed capital, by-laws, and management rules. If contributions include real estate or registered tangible assets, formalize as Escritura Pública before a notary. All shareholders must sign in person or through authentic electronically authorized powers.
required_dossiers: Documento Privado de Constitución or Escritura Pública
Passport or cédula of each shareholder
In-kind contribution inventory and valuation report
By-law checklist per Decree 1074/2015
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises defects regarding minority rights or valuation, execute a supplementary private amendment signed by all shareholders or correct the valuation and pay the applicable stamp duty (impuesto de timbre).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Filing and Acquisition of Legal Personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio territorial (Registro Mercantil) integrated with RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument to the Cámara de Comercio for registration in the Registro Mercantil. Pay the fixed registration fee plus the 0.7% registration levy on share capital where applicable. The Chamber then transmits the registration dataset to DIAN for automatic pre-assignment of the RUT. Legal personality attaches on the date of registry inscription.
required_dossiers: Incorporation instrument duly signed and notarized
Name reservation certificate
Formulario Único RUES pre-registration form
Proof of payment of registration fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon a Chamber requirement notice, cure the deficiency within 3-5 business days by supplying missing documents or fees; otherwise the file may be archived, in which case re-presentation with corrected instruments is accepted without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and VAT/Excise Enrollment with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Dirección de Gestión de Impuestos
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the corporate NIT through the MUISCA portal using the pre-assigned RUT. Select ISIC 4632 wholesale of beverages; register as VAT responsible (Régimen Común) and enroll for the national alcohol consumption duty (Impuesto al Consumo de Licores, Ley 1816/2016). Request authorization for electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) and obtain the digital signature certificate.
required_dossiers: Pre-RUT certificate issued by the Chamber of Commerce
Legal representative identification and powers
Shareholders' tax identification documents
Digital signature certificate (firma electrónica)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT responsibilities, correct the CIUO code and tax classification through MUISCA and resubmit; formal appeals against incorrect NIT data may be filed with the local DIAN collection office within 12 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bonded Warehouse Authorization and Alcohol Customs Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN Subdirección de Gestión de Aduanas and the Departamento Liquor Monopoly Authority (Rentas Departamentales de Licores)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a Deposito de Aduana para Vinos y Licores (bonded storage authorization) at the regional DIAN customs office having jurisdiction over the warehouse. Demonstrate secure enclosure, CCTV monitoring, tamper-proof container seals, and a certified stock control system. Concurrently obtain the departmental liquor importer/distributor permit under Ley 1816/2016 before receiving any Scotch whisky or Bordeaux wine consignments.
required_dossiers: Warehouse boundary survey and location certificate
Security and inventory control manual approved by DIAN
DIAN bonded warehouse application form
Customs guaranty bond calculation (Póliza en favor de la DIAN)
Alcohol movement log template and laboratory compliance certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Refusal of the bonded authorization may be appealed through recurso de reposición within one month; if the physical inspection fails remediation works, complete the enclosure upgrades and request a fresh DIAN verification visit before reapplying.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating Permits and Labour Enrolment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal (Industria y Comercio office) and Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the economic activity in the municipal Registro de Industria y Comercio under category 4632 and obtain the operating licence for alcoholic beverage storage. Enroll all employees with the social security system (EPS, pension fund and ARL). File monthly self-withholdings with ICBF and SENA. For warehouse premises above 2,000 m², obtain the structural load certification for pallet racks.
required_dossiers: RUT and NIT certificates
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal from the Chamber of Commerce
Lease contract or property title for the warehouse
Cuerpo de Bomberos fire safety certificate
ARL enrolment receipt and occupational health plan
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Municipal refusal is cured by filing the emergency response plan and paying the annual ICA operating fee; labour registration gaps are regularized through a corrective plan submitted to the Inspector de Trabajo before any audit.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – Subdirección de Gestión de Aduanas, coordinated with the Departamental Liquor Monopoly (Rentas Departamentales de Licores) under Ley 1816 of 2016.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de Operación de Depósito de Vinos y Licores (Wine and Spirits Bonded Storage Operating Licence).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Agencia Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) for nationally significant projects; Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) for regional warehouse licensing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Registration with Plan de Manejo Ambiental (PMA); full Environmental Impact Assessment is not required for bonded storage facilities below 10,000 t capacity or outside protected buffer zones, but a Diagnóstico Ambiental de Alternativas may be requested for warehouses in sensitive areas.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limits per Resolution 0631/2015 (TSS 400 mg/L, COD 1,000 mg/L, BOD 500 mg/L); volatile organic compound emissions must not exceed 400 mg/m³ per Resolution 909/2008; alcohol wash-water and spill residues must be disposed of through licensed hazardous waste handlers with ANLA or CAR permits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos fire safety certificate covering smoke detection, fire-break zones and extinguishing systems; Dirección Local de Gestión del Riesgo structural load inspection for racking and warehouse mezzanines; INVIMA registry for handling of beverages intended for human consumption; ARL occupational health clearance and workplace emergency response plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal: www.dian.gov.co (Sede Electrónica DIAN)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Colombian SAS formed by foreign shareholders must first obtain NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) via notarial deed, commercial registry filing with the local Chamber of Commerce, and mandatory enrollment in RUT (Registro Único Tributario) at DIAN. NIT serves as both corporate tax ID and VAT ID. The RUT application must be signed through the electronic Sede Electrónica DIAN and may require a resident legal representative if no Colombian branch office exists.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; resident SAS is a separate corporate taxpayer subject to Colombian income tax on worldwide income. No pass-through treatment. A foreign Parent is not attributed the SAS tax results except under controlled foreign corporation rules.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Colombia. Available elections include (i) income tax consolidation for qualifying domestic groups with >70% indirect ownership, (ii) election to be taxed under the optional SIMPLE regime for low-turnover taxpayers (provided business activity restrictions permit; bonded liquor wholesale is generally excluded), and (iii) prior authorization for fiscal price-transfer margins in the customs bonded regime. Hybrid mismatch elections are unavailable; Colombia applies anti-hybrid rules under its CFC legislation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA (Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Colombian Value Added Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No fixed economic turnover threshold triggers VAT liability. Any entity, including a bonded warehouse wholesaler of wine and spirits, is legally obliged to obtain RUT registration, NIT, and VAT identification before commencing taxable shipments or imports. Simplified VAT regime applies only to certain small retailers, not to bonded trade operators.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (facturación electrónica) is required at the time of each taxable transaction. Invoices must be generated as XML/CII and transmitted to DIAN for validación in near-real-time through an authorized software provider, web-service API, or DIAN ’s free electronic platform. Each invoice receives a CUFE or CUDS digital stamp; no invoice is deemed valid for tax offsetting or export refund without DIAN reception and acceptance. Indexed customs and logistics records must be synchronized with the Muisca system for bonded movements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rate VAT applies to exports of tangible goods, including Scotch whisky, Bordeaux wines, and other spirits, when the goods physically leave the Colombian customs territory under a definitive export regime. Sales from a customs bonded warehouse to a foreign buyer are eligible only if followed by a final export declaration (Form 470). Supply of services to foreign beneficiaries qualifies if the services are exclusively used outside Colombia and the recipient has no domicile or establishment in Colombia. Specific documentary and customs disposal rules apply to bonded stock transfers into mainland Colombia.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Form 470 – Declaración de Exportación (Customs Export Declaration) definitively accepted by DIAN
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (or equivalent multimodal transport document) evidencing departure from a Colombian port or airport
Commercial export invoice referencing NIT, RUT, and bonded warehouse regime code
Export contract or purchase order issued by the foreign customer
Foreign-currency payment certificate (Certificado de Ingreso y Pago al Exterior) or equivalent inward telegram evidencing repatriation of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may undertake post-audits for up to five years after export filing. False or unsupported zero-rating claims result in immediate re-invoicing of the omitted IVA at 19%, plus moratorium interest (approximately 12% per annum, subject to monthly actuarial updates) and penalties up to 200% of the inaccurate tax claim. Pure export fraud can trigger a two-year prohibition on obtaining export refunds and CIDC (Comité de Impuestos); criminal customs liability under Law 1762/2015 may impose imprisonment for smuggling or customs false documentation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia; foreign-exchange supervision and enforcement coordinate through the Comité de Cambios and the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) for customs-linked currency formality.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed but broadly convertible exchange system. Current-account transactions are fully channeled through the authorized foreign-exchange market with minimal documentary burden, while capital-account inflows and outflows require investor registration, declaration of change, and compliance with the national exchange regime. Profit remittance is permitted for registered foreign investment after the applicable annual income tax return, the formal registration of the investment with the Banco de la República, and provision of the corresponding Formulario No. 4 or equivalent channeling declaration. Bonded-warehouse wholesale of wine and spirits requires careful documentary support because alcohol trade is treated as enhanced-risk for money-laundering and tax-evasion controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds must be channeled through an authorized bank in Colombia within six months of the invoice date or the date of exportation, unless a verified extension is granted. Mandatory conversion ratios are governed by the national exchange regime; current practical application does not impose a fixed surrender percentage but requires all export proceeds to be negotiated or sold in the foreign-exchange market through an authorized intermediary, typically converting at the market rate on the day of channeling. For bonded-trade operations, proceeds from re-export of wines and spirits remain subject to the same channeling duty, and no direct offshore retention is permitted unless previously authorized by the central bank.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for the core treasury function. Colombian law does not recognize offshore digital EMIs, such as Wise or Revolut-style platforms, as authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries for corporate capital-channeling purposes. Such entities may assist informational transfers but cannot satisfy the legal obligation of channeling export proceeds or making COP-denominated tax and payroll payments. Domestic fintech platforms (e.g., Nequi and Filigrania) are limited to local retail payment instruments and do not replace a licensed commercial bank for cross-border trade settlements, FX declarations, or imports under documentary credits.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is generally available for standard corporate entities; however, because the bonded warehouse of wine and spirits is classified as medium-risk enhanced, most Tier 1 Colombian banks require at least one in-person or video-verification interview with the legal representative, all signatories, and one majority beneficial owner. Physical appearance in Bogotá is strongly recommended for the primary banking relationship. The interview must take place with original stamped and apostilled corporate documents, valid passport(s), the RUT (Registro Único Tributario), and a current certificate of existence issued by the Cámara de Comercio.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: corporate name or primary business not sufficiently distinguished from a wine trader without verified physical bonded warehouse facilities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the official bonded warehouse license issued by the territorial customs authority, a recent inspection certificate from the Cámara de Comercio, the lease or ownership title for the licensed warehouse, and a sworn inventory ledger reconciled with excise-tax declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: ultimate beneficial owners holding senior public positions or unverified source of private wealth.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a documented ownership chart, duly notarized personal statement of wealth, tax returns of each UBO for the preceding two years, a public-official conflict-of-interest declaration, and a copy of internal corporate AML and PEP detection procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: inbound equity injection from a non-resident party in a high-risk jurisdiction not registered as a foreign investor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: File the formal foreign-investment registration form (Formulario No. 4) with the Banco de la República, provide a bank reference letter from the sending institution, an audited certificate of the offshore investee, and legalized incorporation deeds of the parent company showing unencumbered ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: high-velocity cross-border trade expected to be funded with denser SWIFT traffic in a bonded warehouse without established commercial documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide complete sales contracts, logistic operator agreements, customs entry and exit certificates, insurance coverage for spirit storage, and a reconciled history of prior excise-tax payments; include a cash-flow forecast in USD and COP.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound foreign-direct-capital routing must first channel funds to the local bank account held in the name of the Colombian S.A.S. through an authorized intermediary, using a wire message that names the foreign investor as the remitter and the Colombian company as beneficiary. The funds must be identified with the proper channeling purpose code in the Banco de la República's foreign-exchange form—typically Formulario No. 4 (Declaración de Cambio para Inversiones Internacionales) or the applicable computerized declaration for capital contributions—and the investment must be registered within the applicable window after the operation. The bank will verify the tax identification numbers of both parties, the declared amount, and the consistency of the beneficiary's business purpose with the registered economic activity under ISIC 4632. Funds for working capital that are not registered as direct investment may be blocked by the bank's foreign-exchange compliance desk, so the company must instruct the remitting investor to follow an equity or capital-contribution purpose code and must not combine trade financings with equity injections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for the purchase or clearance of wine and spirits from bonded warehouses must be settled through the local bank using SWIFT MT103 for plain wire transfers of import-payment channeling declarations, or through a Commercial Letter of Credit—typically an irrevocable documentary credit per UCP600—for larger or sensitive trade disbursements in which the bank must authenticate invoices, bills of lading, and excise certificates. Payment instructions must carry the correct purpose code (importaciones de bienes), the DIAN import declaration number, and a reference to the purchase order, to allow the bank to complete the national exchange regime reporting. Disbursements from an operational account in COP to a foreign beneficiary in USD will be automatically converted at the bank's prevailing FX rate; the corporate must however pre-register the operation through the bank's electronic platform to avoid a compliance hold.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward exchange contracts with authorized commercial banks, entered into for the documented foreign-exchange exposure arising from wine and spirits import or export contracts.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) permitted for non-resident counterparties hedging their exposure on COP where genuine underlying commercial exposure is evidenced.
FX swaps (compraventa simultánea) and cross-currency swaps, available from tier-1 banks provided the operation is registered in the national exchange system and has a lawful underlying transaction.

stage_5.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory Revisor Fiscal (statutory auditor) if total assets exceed 5,000 SMMLV (~COP 7,117,500,000 for 2025), gross income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV (~COP 4,270,500,000), or if the company has more than 30 shareholders; mandatory independent external audit additionally applies to Grupo 1 (public interest) entities under Decreto 2420/2015.
stage_5.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS (Grupo 1) for listed/public interest; otherwise IFRS for SMEs (NIIF para las PYMES, Grupo 2) per Law 1314/2009 and Decreto 2420/2015, with annual financial statements as of December 31.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Colombian national corporate income tax under Art. 240 Estatuto Tributario; financial and utilities surcharges disregarded for a standard S.A.S. bonded wholesale trader).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No blanket statutory tax holiday for bonded wine and spirits wholesale trade. Selective renta exenta regimes may apply only to sectors such as ecotourism, cultural publishing, agro-industrial new enterprises, and technology investments under Law 1819/2016 and Decree 1650/2017; none are applicable to a bonded warehouse trading company without a specific statutory grant. General deductions for labour, transportation, warehousing, and financing are otherwise available under ordinary CAS principles.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios; filed electronically through the DIAN Muisca portal (www.muisca.dian.gov.co) using a duly registered legal representative and active electronic signature.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (calendar fiscal year); withholding and sales tax filings remain monthly or bimonthly under DIAN rules.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due during April of the following fiscal year in accordance with the DIAN-filed 'calendario tributario' keyed to the last digit of the NIT; e.g., FY2024 returns generally fall between 14 April and 22 April 2025. No general extension for ordinary filers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number, corporate name, S.A.S. form, registered address, and foreign shareholder identification data.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders are not taxed on this return; the S.A.S. must identify each non-resident partner and maintain a Colombian RUT registration and designated agent for service.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISIC/CIIU activity code 4632 for wholesale of alcoholic beverages; add bonded warehouse secondary code if applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The code determines the MFN sector risk classifier in DIAN databases; foreign shareholders may be asked for beneficial ownership declarations under AML regulations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from bonded wholesale sales of aged Scotch and Bordeaux wines, bonded storage fees, handling fees, and any realised currency gains.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All Colombian-source income must be included. Transactions with related foreign suppliers require arm's length prices and transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs: customs duties, bonded warehouse rental, purchase cost of wine/spirits, freight, insurance, salaries, and depreciation. NOL carryforwards are applied separately up to a maximum of five years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border expenses must satisfy the causality test, supporting invoices must be retained, and payments to related foreign entities are subject to transfer pricing and thin capitalisation review.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 – Rentas exentas y descuentos tributarios
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Any statutory exempt profits, investment deductions, or foreign tax credits claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders may not claim personal deductions on the Colombian entity return; treaty relief only applies at the withholding/payment stage and requires a certificate of tax residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of taxable income at 35%, offsetting prepaid taxes, withholding credits, and the balance due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The entity must report the gross dividend withholding base and, when remitting profits to non-residents, must file the corresponding withholding return and pay 10% on the dividend.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties accrue at 5% of the income tax due for each month or fraction, capped at 100% of the tax due, subject to minimum fines in UVT or pesos depending on DIAN assessment. Late payment accrues interest at the indexed default rate (approximately 30%+ per year in a high-rate year). Reckless or fraudulent understatement may attract the full swath of Art. 642-643 E.T. sanctions and criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends paid or credited to non-resident individuals or foreign entities from profits already taxed at the S.A.S. level. If profits are distributed from untaxed or exempt income, an additional compensatory 35% income tax is generally imposed under the Colombian dividend rules (Art. 245 E.T. and related provisions).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: In order to apply an international tax treaty, the non-resident beneficiary must obtain a Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from the competent tax authority of the residence state, submit it to the Colombian paying entity before remittance, and retain it for at least five years. The Colombian S.A.S. must assess treaty eligibility, apply the reduced domestic withholding rate only where the treaty grants it, and maintain the TRC together with any legalised translation and a beneficial-owner statement. DIAN may require electronic registration in Muisca and a local authorised representative before granting reduced source taxation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory source withholding for non-residents is generally 20% for royalty payments and 15–20% for interest paid on cross-border financing, depending on the financial nature of the instrument. Treaty rates vary: Colombia's income tax treaties commonly reduce royalty WHT to 5–10% and interest to 5–15%, subject to the limitation-on-benefits clause and the beneficial-ownership requirement. No comprehensive Colombia–U.S. income tax treaty is in force; Spain, Mexico, Switzerland, the Netherlands, the UK, France, Germany, Portugal, Chile, Canada, and Korea have applicable DTAs.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory transfer pricing obligations apply to an S.A.S. whose gross assets or gross income exceed COP 4,706,500,000 (100,000 UVT for fiscal 2024) and which carries out transactions with related parties, tax-haven jurisdictions, or entities established in no-tax/weltwirt regimes. The Local File threshold is additionally met where intercompany transactions with related parties exceed COP 900,000,000 in the taxable year; Country-by-Country reporting applies to multinational groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not apply the Gulf-style Economic Substance Regulations (ESR). Instead, substance and economic reality are enforced through the Estatuto Tributario general anti-avoidance rule (GAAR, Art. 658 E.T.), anti-abusive reunion of legal entities, substance-over-form jurisprudence by the Consejo de Estado, and the OECD BEPS LOB clauses embedded in Colombia's DTAs. A bonded wine/spirits trading S.A.S. must demonstrate real business functions, physical premises, employees, and assumed risk to withstand tax and AML challenges.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of bonded wine/spirit sales, misclassification of taxable domestic consumption as bonded export, fabrication of purchase invoices, or use of bogus deductible expenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion carries imprisonment from 4 to 9 years and a fine equal to 100% of the tax evaded; civil penalties from DIAN include the 100% inaccurate-declaration penalty, monthly default interest, and confiscatory tax reassessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shareholders who knowingly sign false financial statements or authorise fictitious costs may be personally jointly liable; under Law 1258/2008 (S.A.S. regime) the separate legal personality is pierced when liability is an instrument of fraud. Travel bans and asset embargoes may be applied during criminal tax proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the transfer pricing return or local/master file, maintaining non-arm's-length prices on imported Scotch/Bordeaux purchases, or charging management/royalty fees to a foreign parent without economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may reassess the taxable base at arm's length, add a 30% punitive adjustment on the corrected income, and impose administrative fines of up to 70,000 UVT; excess interest deductions may be disallowed and carryforwards forfeited.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who sign fraudulent transfer pricing documents without real control or substance risk joint criminal responsibility and civil restitution for the unpaid tax; DIAN can reject the corporate veil where the S.A.S. is used to shift profit artificially.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Shell Company / Beneficial Ownership Abuses
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using opaque nominee chains, paying bonded liquor buyers with unmonitored cash, making structured bank deposits, or integrating wine-spirit sale proceeds with unexplained third-party wires through Swift/bonded transfers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering under Colombian Criminal Code Art. 323 carries 8–15 years' imprisonment plus fines up to 10,000 current legal monthly minimum wages; the UIAF may impose administrative fines and freeze corporate assets; the entity may be subject to liquidation if found to be a front company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally exposed to criminal asset forfeiture, travel bans, and extradition where they knowingly facilitated untraceable payments; corporate veil is pierced automatically for money laundering proceeds; professional sanctions, including disqualification from managing commercial companies, may be imposed.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Bonded Warehouse / Customs and Spirits Trade Violations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Unauthorised removal of aged Scotch or wine from bonded premises, false age/origin certificates, tax evasion on spirituous beverages, underbonding, or failing to renew the statutory commercial license for bonded wholesale trade.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN and customs authorities may seize the goods, impose fines equal to 100%–300% of the customs value, revoke the bonded warehouse license, and apply the alcohol tax and import duties retroactively with default interest; repeated breaches justify permanent closure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Company officers who ordered or tolerated the unlawful movement of goods bear direct criminal and customs liability, including imprisonment of 2 to 8 years, personal restitution of lost duties, and prohibition from holding a bonded trade license or serving as directors in customs-regulated companies.
